title: GateReport-v4 Repository-Write Chain-Result Binding
primary_claim: A Gate report can replace its placeholder repository-write authentication failures only after strictly binding one canonical verifier-chain result to the exact source revision, inventory, classification projection, surface identities, candidate blockers, stage applicability and non-runtime applicability identity.
acceptance: a valid exact chain result is bound into GateReport-v4 by schema and canonical digest
foreign source revision, inventory or classification identity is refused
surface path, line, column, origin and binding digest must agree
classification verdict and candidate blockers must be re-derived and agree
stage applicability cannot be shortened to make a conjunction easier
non-runtime conformity applicability requires the exact retained execution identity
a refused or missing chain cannot remove GateReport-v3 authentication failures
a valid but unauthenticated chain replaces placeholders with its actual per-surface pending stages
report and chain inputs are each checked twice for drift
chain schema and digest remain mandatory GateReport-v4 blockers
